goal: Restructure the platform into five load-classed planes, move implementations to Rust only where measurement and a parity oracle justify it, and make performance governable by separating local from provider SLIs, with zero public contract change.
last_result: Program authored 2026-08-26 from a verified survey of the current tree. Six items on the 2026-08-17 SPO list were confirmed already fixed and four more obsolete after the Python AgentLoop deletion; they are excluded in PRD section 2.5.
next_action: Start PPR-00: split local_overhead_seconds from ttft_seconds in the probe, characterise provider variance at >=30 trials, and gate only the local SLI.

features.description: Local overhead and provider latency are two independently reported and independently gated SLIs, and provider variance is characterised at N>=30.
steps: Derive local_overhead_seconds from gateway-owned timestamps only.
Report p50/p95/IQR for both SLIs at >=30 trials.
Gate the local SLI; report the provider SLI without gating it.
Freeze a digest-pinned rollback bundle at the program start commit.

features.description: One command takes a one-line Rust edit to a healthy container in under 15 minutes, on a service-sized image, without rebuilding unrelated crates.
steps: Move the runtime stage off the toolchain base image.
Derive every downstream image pin from lock.json instead of duplicating it.
Compute overlay identity per crate.
Record the measured edit-to-container wall time.

features.description: The plane topology exists as an accepted ADR and as a gate that fails on a boundary violation, before any code moves.
steps: Write ADR-008 with the five planes, their SLO classes, and hard rules H1-H8.
Record plane ownership as data so docs and gate cannot disagree.
Add make plane-boundary-gate and register it in harness.yml and docs/harness/commands.md.
Prove the gate fails on an injected violation.

features.description: Edge responsibilities run as their own multi-worker unit with their own budget, preserving the already-correct admission and rate-limit behaviour.
steps: Split the edge out of the gateway process boundary without rewriting it.
Keep single-EVAL admission and dimension-skip rate limiting exactly as they are.
Prove zero oversell under a multi-worker fuzz.
Measure edge p99 added latency and gateway RSS delta.

features.description: A Rust model plane proves byte-identical SSE projection in shadow and is adopted only if it clears its memory gate.
steps: Preserve ADR-007 lease, snapshot, and single-provider-call semantics.
Run both implementations in shadow and diff outputs.
Prove byte-identical fixture replay including error and cancellation frames.
Adopt only on >=60% RSS reduction at 50 concurrent streams; otherwise close as measured-not-adopted.

features.description: Governance runs apart from execution and the edge, and can no longer squeeze the request path.
steps: Move Eval, trace consumption, and audit surfaces to their own unit.
Keep lifecycle, capability catalog, policy, Studio, and billing on the control plane.
Prove a heavy eval batch does not move streaming p99 or the local SLI.
Show a >=30% gateway RSS reduction against the PPR-00 baseline.

features.description: Ingestion scales horizontally without touching interactive retrieval latency, and any native kernel proves byte-identical output first.
steps: Scale knowledge-worker beyond one worker with safe claim semantics.
Add an interactive retrieval profile distinct from the eval profile.
Prove a 200-page ingest raises retrieval p99 by at most 10%.
Ship native chunk kernels only on byte-identical boundaries; otherwise cancel and record.

features.description: Conversation history has one normalized home and the gateway path stops writing the unbounded JSONB column.
steps: Project gateway session reads and writes from assistant_runtime_items.
Migrate or freeze legacy history payloads reversibly.
Preserve the audit chain and the tombstone-on-delete behaviour.
Prove render parity for legacy sessions through the public API.

features.description: Provider-side configuration is A/B tested with real evidence, and the product ceiling is either met or replaced with an evidenced number.
steps: Measure at least three model/variant/cache configurations at >=30 trials each.
Report prompt-cache hit rate per configuration.
Reject any configuration that wins latency and loses the eight-scenario cohort.
Conclude with a met ceiling or an evidenced replacement ceiling.

features.description: The restructured platform has a serial release contract and a rehearsed, digest-pinned rollback that preserves sessions and the execution ledger.
steps: Extend the release gate across every plane.
Rehearse current-to-frozen-to-current with fingerprint equality.
Refresh the rollback evidence so it names the images actually shipped.
Publish a program report covering every gate number and every cancelled sub-item.
